sentences: Against a dark background, a girl glances over her shoulder, lips slightly parted, as if we have just caught her attention.
It is not a portrait of a specific person but a tronie, a Dutch genre for studying exotic costumes and expressions.
The blue of her turban is ultramarine, ground from lapis lazuli and more costly than gold at the time.
Look closely at the famous pearl: it has no outline at all, only a soft reflection of her white collar below and a single bright highlight above.
There is not even a hook attaching it to her ear.
Vermeer lets your eye complete the rest, and that is the magic of the painter of light.
